newsitem.title: USA: Universal hires firm to explore options.
newsitem.headline: Universal hires firm to explore options.

text.p: Universal Seismic Associates Inc said Monday that it hired Morgan Keegan Inc to assist it in exploring, developing and recommending various strategic alternatives designed to enhance shareholder value.

These alternatives may include the possible merger or business combination of the company with another entity as well as capital raising or recapitalization strategies, a news release issued by Universal said.
